entities.name: Monetize
entities.description: The Genuin product line under which the Ad Prioritisation Logic for video feed placements is defined.

entities.name: Ad Prioritisation Logic
entities.description: The rules that determine which ads appear in each paginated page of 10 videos on a placement, ordering takeovers, sponsored posts, and programmatic fallback.

entities.name: Video Feed Placement
entities.description: A surface that serves video feeds in paginated calls of 10 videos each and on which managed ad types can be configured.

entities.name: Paginated View
entities.description: A single page of 10 video slots delivered by the video feed placement; the unit at which ad prioritisation and slot allocation are evaluated.

entities.name: Sponsored Takeover
entities.description: A managed ad type that occupies the entire paginated view exclusively when active, suppressing sponsored posts and programmatic ads on that page.

entities.name: Sponsored Post
entities.description: A managed ad type that occupies only the designated in-feed ad slots within a paginated view, competing with other sponsored posts by CPM.

entities.name: Programmatic Ad
entities.description: Fallback ad type that fills in-feed slots when no sponsored post is eligible or when sponsored post budgets are exhausted.

entities.name: Organic Content
entities.description: Non-ad video content that fills remaining slots in a paginated view when ads do not occupy every slot.

entities.name: CPM Configuration
entities.description: Placement-level configuration capturing the bid value of a takeover or sponsored post; used to order competing ads from highest to lowest.

entities.name: Ad Duration Configuration
entities.description: The flight window within which a sponsored takeover or sponsored post is eligible to serve on a placement.

entities.name: Creative Videos Configuration
entities.description: The set of videos a sponsor supplies for a takeover or sponsored post; drives the cycling behaviour across slots and pages.

entities.name: In-Feed Ad Slots Configuration
entities.description: Placement-level configuration controlling how many of the 10 slots in a paginated view are reserved for in-feed sponsored post ads.

entities.name: Allow Content To Play With Sponsored Takeover
entities.description: Per-takeover configuration controlling whether organic content can fill slots not occupied by the takeover's creative videos on a takeover page.

entities.name: Takeover Video Cycling
entities.description: Algorithm that cycles a takeover's creative videos through a circular buffer with a sliding window of 10, advancing by 10 modulo N each page.

entities.name: Sponsored Post Video Cycling
entities.description: Algorithm that cycles a sponsored post's creative videos across the available in-feed ad slots on every page via a circular buffer.

entities.name: Takeover Exclusivity Rule
entities.description: Rule that an active sponsored takeover is the exclusive ad type for that page, suppressing all sponsored posts and other takeovers on the same placement.

entities.name: Priority Order
entities.description: Ordering used when filling a paginated view: sponsored takeovers by CPM, then sponsored posts by CPM within in-feed slots, then programmatic as fallback.

entities.name: User-Level Frequency Caps
entities.description: Planned per-user-per-day or per-user-per-session ceiling on how many times a sponsored post's creative videos can be shown to the same user, diversifying user experience while preserving CPM-driven delivery.

entities.name: Sponsored Post Repeatability
entities.description: User-experience consequence of the cycling rules where a single user can see the same sponsored post's creative videos multiple times within a page and across consecutive pages.

relationships.description: The Ad Prioritisation Logic document defines behaviour for the Monetize product.
Video feed placements are surfaces governed by the Monetize product.
Video feeds on a placement are served in paginated calls of 10 videos each, i.e. paginated views.
The prioritisation logic determines what appears in each paginated view of 10 slots.
The logic enforces the priority order of takeovers, sponsored posts, then programmatic fallback.
Sponsored takeovers sit at the top of the priority order, sorted by CPM highest first.
Sponsored posts come next in the priority order, sorted by CPM within available in-feed slots.
Programmatic ads serve as the fallback layer in the priority order for unfilled in-feed slots.
Sponsored takeovers are one of the managed ad types configurable on a video feed placement.
Sponsored posts are one of the managed ad types configurable on a video feed placement.
Programmatic ads fill in-feed slots on the placement when sponsored posts are not eligible or are exhausted.
Sponsored takeovers are configured with a CPM that orders competing takeovers from highest to lowest.
Sponsored takeovers are configured with a duration that bounds the flight window of eligibility.
Sponsored takeovers use a configured set of creative videos that are cycled through the paginated view.
Sponsored posts use CPM to compete for in-feed slots, highest first.
Sponsored posts use a duration that bounds their eligibility window.
Sponsored posts use a configured set of creative videos that are cycled across in-feed slots.
Sponsored posts occupy only the in-feed ad slots defined by the placement's slot configuration.

relationships.target: Allow Content To Play With Sponsored Takeover
relationships.description: Each takeover has its own Allow Content flag that controls whether organic content interleaves with takeover creative videos.

relationships.source: Allow Content To Play With Sponsored Takeover
relationships.description: When enabled, slots beyond the takeover's creative count are filled with organic content; when disabled, no organic content is interleaved.
Takeovers cycle their creative videos through a sliding window of 10 across pages, advancing by 10 modulo N each page.
Sponsored posts cycle their creative videos across the available in-feed slots on every page.
An active takeover is the exclusive ad type for that page, suppressing sponsored posts and other takeovers.
While any takeover is active, sponsored posts are suppressed on that placement.
In-feed slots not filled by an eligible sponsored post fall back to programmatic ads.
A paginated view contains the number of in-feed ad slots set by the placement-level configuration, with the remainder available for organic content.
Paginated views include organic content in slots not occupied by ads.
Frequency caps will limit how many times a sponsored post's creative videos can be shown to the same user within a capping window.
Frequency caps are the planned remedy for the within-page and cross-page repetition users currently experience under the cycling rules.
Repeatability for a user arises because the active sponsored post's videos cycle to fill every available in-feed slot under the current rules.
Frequency caps may later be extended to sponsored takeovers to prevent repeated exposure across pages, though this is out of scope for the current release.
